name: 7642-sharegpt-gemma2-27b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, one node. 54.4 GB of bf16 weights fit one 80 GB card with room for a KV pool.
architecture: dense decoder (Gemma2ForCausalLM), 46 layers, hidden 4608, 32 query / 16 KV heads at head_dim 128, bf16, 27.2B parameters; KV per token 368 KiB. The rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 64, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 1333 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, which leaves exactly 1000 measured requests.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `configs/data/sharegpt-2000-gemma2.jsonl` -- 2000 real ShareGPT first-turn pairs (prompt mean 237, p90 668, max 1013; output mean 213, p90 515, max 1876), single turn, `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 1.0`, `top_p: 1.0`. Every row carries its reply's own token count and the backend sets `max_tokens` with `ignore_eos=True`, so decode work per request is fixed. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates the file under seed 0.
purpose: A 27-billion-parameter chat assistant handling single-turn conversational prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 8c6f694a79d7a607ef9ba1f865c610f15c3fc2a4, `git describe --tags`
# v0.5.4-218-g8c6f694a79d7 (2024-08-22). Keys are read as this era's engine arguments.

# `unsloth/...` is the ungated mirror of `google/gemma-2-27b-it` and agrees with it on every shape
# field. NOT in the local HF cache: the first run pays a ~55 GB download across 12 shards.
model: unsloth/gemma-2-27b-it

# One card. 27.2B x bf16 = 54.4 GB of weights fits an 80 GB H100 with room for a KV pool.
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Engine defaults at this commit, written out so a future default cannot drift them. max-num-seqs
# does not bind: the load is a closed loop of 64 streams, so at most 64 sequences ever exist.
max-num-seqs: 256
enforce-eager: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
seed: 0

# `max-model-len` is deliberately absent, and this engine does not leave the choice open for
# gemma2: it force-disables the sliding window and caps the resolved length to the window, 4096,
# warning at startup as it does so. Because that is not above 32768, chunked prefill does not
# auto-enable, so a prompt is prefilled in one step. Every request in configs/data/ is filtered to
# prompt + output <= 2048, so the cap is never reached.
